$comment: The registry of libraries under test. `status` is the state of the ADAPTER, not the library's accessibility. Never publish a score for a target whose adapter has not been reviewed.

targets.name: React Spectrum
targets.notes: Calibration control. Widely regarded as the accessibility gold standard. If the harness does not score this near-perfect, the harness is wrong. Must be implemented and passing before ANY result is published.

targets.name: Radix UI
targets.notes: Reference adapter implementation. Read this one first when writing a new adapter.

targets.name: shadcn/ui
targets.notes: Copy-paste distribution built on Radix. The open question is whether the copy-paste model preserves or degrades the upstream behaviour. Pin the CLI version and the date the components were generated, not just a package version.
